cases.clinical_source: ? mycosis fungoides. PCR Result TCR polyclonal
cases.comment_source: Immunohistochemistry results: CD2+ CD3+ CD4+ CD5+ CD7+/- CD8- PCR Result: TCR polyclonal Morphology and comment: This skin biopsy shows thickened epidermis with hyperkeratosis and focal parakeratosis. There is an upper dermal infiltrate consisting mainly of small lymphocytes with macrophages and occasional eosinophils. Within the epidermis there is a population of atypical T cells. These cells are of intermediate size and many have highly irregular nuclei. Pautrier abscesses are present. The features are those of plaque phase mycosis fungoides.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Mycosis fungoides [9700/3] PubMed Comment: Immunohistochemistry results: CD2+ CD3+ CD4+ CD5+ CD7+/- CD8- PCR Result: TCR polyclonal Morphology and comment: This skin biopsy shows thickened epidermis with hyperkeratosis and focal parakeratosis. There is an upper dermal infiltrate consisting mainly of small lymphocytes with macrophages and occasional eosinophils. Within the epidermis there is a population of atypical T cells. These cells are of intermediate size and many have highly irregular nuclei. Pautrier abscesses are present. The features are those of plaque phase mycosis fungoides.
cases.category_cs: Hematolymfoidní, systémová, metastatická a ostatní vzácná onemocnění
cases.comment_cs: Imunohistochemie: CD2+ CD3+ CD4+ CD5+ CD7+/- CD8-. PCR: TCR polyklonální. Morfologie: biopsie kůže ukazuje ztluštělou epidermis s hyperkeratózou a ložiskovou parakeratózou. V horní dermis je infiltrát tvořený převážně malými lymfocyty s makrofágy a ojedinělými eozinofily. V epidermis je populace atypických T-buněk střední velikosti, mnohé s výrazně nepravidelnými jádry. Přítomny jsou Pautrierovy mikroabscesy. Nález odpovídá plakové fázi mycosis fungoides.

cases.clinical_source: Lesions in right scapular region and right inguinal region. ? T cell lymphoma.
cases.comment_source: Immunohistochemistry results: Mib-120% CD10- CD20- CD2+ CD3+ CD4+ CD5+ CD7- CD8- PCR Result: failed Morphology & Comments: These skin biopsies from both regions show similar changes. The extent of infiltration however is greater in biopsy B from the right inguinal region. In both specimens there is extensive infiltration of the dermis by large T cells with irregular nuclei and multiple nucleoli. There is relative sparing of the epidermis and the rate of cell proliferation is modest. This is cutaneous infiltration by a peripheral T cell lymphoma.

cases.diagnosis_source: Primary cutaneous CD30 positive T-cell LPD [9718/3]
cases.comment_source: Immunohistochemistry: CD2+ CD3+ CD4+ CD5+/- CD7- CD30+ CD8- PCR Result: Though amplification was sub optimal, TCR appears polyclonal. Morphology comments: The skin biopsy shows a well circumscribed upper dermal lesion associated with a hyperplastic epidermis. The lesion consists of a perivascular and diffuse infiltrate of reactive small lymphocytes associated with [click to expand/collapse] oedema. At the centre of the lesion there is an ill-defined cluster of atypical large lymphoid cells. Theses strongly express CD30. This is a cutaneous CD 30 positive T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder. A definitive diagnosis between lymphomatoid papulosis and T-cell lymphoma can only be made on the basis of disease regression. cases.clinical_source: Rapidly enlarging nodule on foot. Bleeding +++. ?pyogenic granuloma, ?amelanotic melanoma.
cases.comment_source: The full thickness of the dermis is filled by a highly cellular, mitotically active, spindled and epitheloid neoplasm. There is a suggestion of slit-like vascular spaces and interspersed plasma cells. A junctional component and melanin pigment are not identified. Ulceration is present. Immunohistochemistry shows strong, diffuse positivity for vascular markers (CD31 and CD34). 100, HMB45, MNF116, actin and desmin are negative. This is a classical-type Kaposi's sarcoma.

cases.comment_cs: Celá tloušťka dermis je vyplněna vysoce celulární, mitoticky aktivní vřetenobuněčnou a epiteloidní neoplazií. Naznačeny jsou štěrbinovité vaskulární prostory a mezi nádorovými buňkami jsou plazmocyty. Junkční komponenta ani melaninový pigment nejsou přítomny. Je přítomna ulcerace. IHC ukazuje silnou difuzní pozitivitu vaskulárních markerů CD31 a CD34. S100, HMB45, MNF116, aktin a desmin jsou negativní. Jde o klasický typ Kaposiho sarkomu.

cases.clinical_source: Cyst removed from scalp. Macroscopic description - skin with underlying cyst containing haemorrhagic and focally gelatinous material.
cases.comment_source: Histology shows a cystic structure filled with amorphous acellular eosinophilic material. Focally, a circumscribed cellular area is seen to consist of trabeculated cords of basaloid cells interspersed by large ectatic vessles, many of which show perivascular hyalinisation (so-called "ancient" changes). At higher magnification, two distinct populations of cell are seen. Small, basaloid cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and larger pale cells with vesicular nuclei and ample pale cytoplasm. A characteristic feature is the presence of eosinophilic globules throughout the entire neoplasm, sometimes surrounded by neoplastic cells in pseudorosette fashion. This is a cystic eccrine spiradenoma.

cases.comment_cs: Histologicky je přítomna cystická struktura vyplněná amorfním acelulárním eozinofilním materiálem. Ložiskově je ohraničená celulární oblast tvořená trabekulárními pruhy bazaloidních buněk mezi velkými ektatickými cévami, mnohé s perivaskulární hyalinizací („ancient“ změny). Ve větším zvětšení jsou patrné dvě populace: malé bazaloidní buňky s hyperchromními jádry a větší světlé buňky s vezikulárními jádry a hojnou světlou cytoplazmou. Charakteristické jsou eozinofilní globule v celé neoplazii, někdy obklopené nádorovými buňkami ve formě pseudorozet. Jde o cystický ekrinní spiradenom.

cases.clinical_source: Blistering lesions of buccal mucosa and skin. Biopsy of buccal mucosa.
cases.comment_source: The biopsy shows stratified squamous epithelium in which suprabasilar acantholysis is present resulting in a low epidermal cleavage plane. Single rows of basal keratinocytes remain adherent to the basement membrane producing a "tombstone-like" pattern. The associated inflammation in the lamina propria consists of lymphocytes, plasma cells and eosinophils. Direct immunofluorescence on this case showed squamous cell intracellular staining for IgG and weak staining for C3D. These features are in keeping with pemphigus vulgaris.

Jednotlivé řady bazálních keratinocytů zůstávají přichycené k bazální membráně a vytvářejí obraz „řady náhrobních kamenů“. Zánětlivý infiltrát v lamina propria tvoří lymfocyty, plazmocyty a eozinofily. Přímá imunofluorescence prokázala intracelulární barvení dlaždicových buněk pro IgG a slabé barvení C3D. Nález odpovídá pemphigus vulgaris.

cases.comment_source: A section of skin showing a dilated hair follicle-like cystic structure that is seen to contain loose keratinous material. The cyst epithelial lining contains a granular layer and is in continuity with the surface epidermis. The deep aspect of the cyst connects to multiple, radially arranged sebaceous structures that are enveloped in dense fibromuscular stroma. This unusual lesion is a folliculosebaceous cystic hamartoma and is completely benign.

cases.diagnosis_source: Neurofibroma with atypical cells and myxoid degeneration
cases.comment_source: Skin showing an encapsulated intra-dermal lesion composed of moderately pleomorphic epitheloid and spindle cells possessing irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei. Mitoses are not identified. The background stroma is predominantly myxoid and contains small blood vessels. Immunohistochemistry showed positivity for S100 but no staining was observed with cytokeratins, SMA, desmin, caldesmon, CD30, melan-A or HMB-45. This lesion likely represents a degenerative neurofibroma.

Because of the history of previous fungal infection, disseminated disease may be present in this patient.

cases.clinical_source: Nodular lesion from behind ear. Pigmented. Clinically suspicious.
cases.comment_source: Sections of skin showing epidermis overlying a highly sclerotic dermis. The epidermis contains a subtle melanocytic proliferation in which scattered single melanocytes display occasional cytological atypia. The dermis, however, harbours an ill-defined spindle cell population which is seen to extend into the deep dermal layers and to all surgical margins. The spindle cells display mild cytological atypia in the absence of any mitotic activity and stain diffusely with S100. This is a desmoplastic melanoma.

The dermis, however, harbours an ill-defined spindle cell population which is seen to extend into the deep dermal layers and to all surgical margins. The spindle cells display mild cytological atypia in the absence of any mitotic activity and stain diffusely with S100. This is a desmoplastic melanoma.

V dermis je neostře ohraničená populace vřetenitých buněk zasahující do hluboké dermis a ke všem chirurgickým okrajům. Vřetenité buňky vykazují mírnou cytologickou atypii bez mitotické aktivity a difuzně se barví pro S100. Jde o desmoplastický melanom.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows sun-damaged skin in which an endophytic squamoproliferative lesion is seen to display a 'crateriform' (crater-like) architectural appearance. The intra-lesional squamous cells are much larger, more eosinophilic and show mild nuclear atypia when compared to the normal adjacent epidermal cells. Deep to the lesion, well-vascularised stroma shows dense infiltration by chronic inflammatory cells as well as a focal foreign-body type reaction to keratin. Within the deep stroma, beyond the sweat glands, further islands of abnormal squamous cells are seen. With further levels (not shown here), these islands are in continuity with the surface lesional epithelium. No perineural or vascular invasion is identified. Differentials to consider in this case include keratoacanthoma or a well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma. The presence of abnormal cells beyond the depth of the eccrine glands suggest that this lesion is best regarded as a well-differentiated SCC despite minimal cellular atypia.

cases.comment_cs: Sluncem poškozená kůže obsahuje endofytickou skvamoproliferativní lézi kráteriformní architektury. Intralezionální dlaždicové buňky jsou větší, eozinofilnější a s mírnou jadernou atypií oproti okolní epidermis. V hloubce je dobře vaskularizované stroma s denzním chronickým zánětlivým infiltrátem a ložiskovou reakcí cizího tělesa na keratin. Za úrovní potních žláz jsou další ostrůvky abnormálních dlaždicových buněk, které v hlubších řezech navazují na povrchový epitel léze. Perineurální ani vaskulární invaze není patrná. Diferenciálně přichází v úvahu keratoakantom nebo dobře diferencovaný spinocelulární karcinom. Přítomnost abnormálních buněk hlouběji než ekrinní žlázy podporuje diagnózu dobře diferencovaného SCC navzdory minimální buněčné atypii.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows several circumscribed nodules that are seen to consist of trabeculated cords of basaloid cells interspersed by large ectatic vessles, many of which show perivascular hyalinisation (so-called "ancient" changes). At higher magnification, two distinct populations of cell are seen. Small, basaloid cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and larger pale cells with vesicular nuclei and ample pale cytoplasm. A characteristic feature is the presence of eosinophilic globules throughout the entire neoplasm, sometimes surrounded by neoplastic cells in pseudorosette fashion. This is an eccrine spiradenoma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Eccrine spiradenoma PubMed Comment: This slide shows several circumscribed nodules that are seen to consist of trabeculated cords of basaloid cells interspersed by large ectatic vessles, many of which show perivascular hyalinisation (so-called "ancient" changes). At higher magnification, two distinct populations of cell are seen. Small, basaloid cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and larger pale cells with vesicular nuclei and ample pale cytoplasm. A characteristic feature is the presence of eosinophilic globules throughout the entire neoplasm, sometimes surrounded by neoplastic cells in pseudorosette fashion. This is an eccrine spiradenoma.
cases.comment_cs: Je přítomno několik ohraničených uzlů tvořených trabekulárními pruhy bazaloidních buněk mezi velkými ektatickými cévami, často s perivaskulární hyalinizací („ancient“ změny). Ve větším zvětšení jsou patrné dvě populace buněk: malé bazaloidní buňky s hyperchromními jádry a větší světlé buňky s vezikulárními jádry a hojnou světlou cytoplazmou. Typické jsou eozinofilní globule v celé neoplazii, někdy obklopené nádorovými buňkami ve formě pseudorozet. Jde o ekrinní spiradenom.

cases.comment_source: These interesting slides shows a polypoid nodule that results from dermal infiltration by a moderate to poorly differentiated mucinous adenocarcinoma. Immunohistochemistry for oestrogen receptor (slide 2) and monoclonal CEA (slide 3) shows diffuse positivity. Focal positivity for CK7 was also noted but CK20, BRST-2 and TTF-1 were all negative. This lesion was reported as being a primary mucinous adenocarcinoma of sweat gland origin. Metastatic breast carcinoma could not be excluded. In such situations, the value of clinicopathological correlation cannot be overstated.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows a punch biopsy on three levels. The skin contains acanthotic epidermis displaying elongation of rete ridges. Two foci of suprabasal clefting are seen to be associated with overlying hyper- and parakeratosis. At the cleft points dykeratotic cells are identified that contain prominent keratohyaline granules. The underlying dermis is inflamed. These appearances are in keeping with Darier's disease.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Darier's disease PubMed Comment: This slide shows a punch biopsy on three levels. The skin contains acanthotic epidermis displaying elongation of rete ridges. Two foci of suprabasal clefting are seen to be associated with overlying hyper- and parakeratosis. At the cleft points dykeratotic cells are identified that contain prominent keratohyaline granules. The underlying dermis is inflamed. These appearances are in keeping with Darier's disease.
cases.comment_cs: Punch biopsie ve třech úrovních ukazuje akantotickou epidermis s prodloužením rete ridges. Dvě ložiska suprabazálního štěpení jsou spojena s hyper- a parakeratózou. V místech štěpení jsou dyskeratotické buňky s výraznými keratohyalinními granuly. Podkladová dermis je zanícená. Nález odpovídá Darierově chorobě.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows spongiosis of the epidermis in association with increased numbers of superficial dermal mast cells (CD117 positive). A mild perivascular lymphocytic infiltrate is also noted alongside some focal exocytosis. This is mastocytosis. Mastocytosis (infiltration of the skin by mast cells) is a relatively common condition, particularly in children where it usually resolves by adulthood. In affected adults, associated systemic symptoms (e.g. gastrointestinal)are more common. These are typically not present in children.

cases.comment_cs: Epidermis vykazuje spongiózu a zvýšený počet mastocytů v povrchové dermis (CD117 pozitivní). Přítomen je mírný perivaskulární lymfocytární infiltrát a ložisková exocytóza. Jde o mastocytózu. Kožní infiltrace mastocyty je relativně častá zejména u dětí, kde obvykle do dospělosti ustoupí. U dospělých jsou častější přidružené systémové, například gastrointestinální, příznaky, které u dětí typicky chybějí.

cases.comment_source: In this rather scanty sample, levels show skin in which hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis, acanthosis and elongated rete ridges are seen. The keratinocytes show both nuclear and cytoplasmic enlargement with the latter being highly eosinophilic. This is a large cell acanthoma. Large cell acanthoma commonly occurs on the sun exposed skin of middle-aged to elderly individuals. The aetiology is thought to be sun light which induces a clonal non-malignant proliferation of altered cells.

cases.comment_cs: V poměrně malém vzorku jsou v hlubších řezech patrné hyperkeratóza, parakeratóza, akantóza a prodloužené rete ridges. Keratinocyty mají zvětšená jádra i cytoplazmu, která je výrazně eozinofilní. Jde o velkobuněčný akantom. Ten se běžně vyskytuje na slunci exponované kůži středně starých a starších osob. Za etiologii se považuje sluneční záření vedoucí ke klonální nemaligní proliferaci změněných buněk.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows skin in which necrotic granulomas are seen within the superficial dermis. An associated mixed inflammatory infiltrate is also present. Multinucleated giant cells enclose foci of eosinophilic degenerative collagen. This is granulomatous inflammation consistent with granuloma annulare, not sarcoid. Granuloma annulare is characterised clinically by the presence of papules and nodules organised in an annular arrangement, typically over extensor surfaces.

Granuloma annulare is characterised clinically by the presence of papules and nodules organised in an annular arrangement, typically over extensor surfaces.
cases.comment_cs: V povrchové dermis jsou nekrotické granulomy se smíšeným zánětlivým infiltrátem. Mnohojaderné obrovské buňky obklopují ložiska eozinofilního degenerovaného kolagenu. Jde o granulomatózní zánět odpovídající granuloma annulare, nikoli sarkoidóze. Klinicky se granuloma annulare projevuje papulami a uzly uspořádanými prstencovitě, typicky na extenzorových plochách.

cases.comment_source: This punch biopsy, seen on levels 1-3, shows normal epidermis. The lower dermis, however, contains numerous epithelioid granulomas in association with many multi-nucleated giant cells. Perivascular chronic and granulomatous inflammation in association with focal fibrinoid change of the vessel wall is suggestive of a vasculitis. The overall appearances are those of erythema induratum. Erythema induratum (of Bazin) is a chronic and recurring panniculitis found mainly on the legs of women with tuberculin hypersensitivity. A relationship between this condition and tuberculosis is not proven due to the absence of such organisms in the lesions.

cases.comment_cs: Punch biopsie v úrovních 1–3 ukazuje normální epidermis. V dolní dermis jsou četné epiteloidní granulomy a mnoho mnohojaderných obrovských buněk. Perivaskulární chronický a granulomatózní zánět s ložiskovými fibrinoidními změnami cévní stěny svědčí pro vaskulitidu. Celkový obraz odpovídá erythema induratum. Erythema induratum (Bazin) je chronická recidivující panikulitida, zejména na dolních končetinách žen s tuberkulinovou hypersenzitivitou. Souvislost s tuberkulózou není definitivně prokázána, protože organismy v lézích obvykle nejsou přítomny.

cases.comment_source: The virtual slide here shows skin in which lobules of squamous epithelium are seen to extend down into the dermis. The lobules contain small basaloid cells that show peripheral palisading. Some of these cells show differentiation towards large eosinophilic keratinocytes. Mild cytological atypia is noted as are occasional mitoses. This is a proliferating trichilemmal tumour. These tumours are generally considered to be borderline lesions but in the latest WHO classification they are grouped as low grade malignant lesions. They can be locally aggressive but metastasis is very rare.

cases.clinical_cs: Léze v okcipitální oblasti hlavy. Ulcerovaná. ?Maligní.
cases.comment_cs: Virtuální preparát ukazuje kůži, v níž lalůčky dlaždicového epitelu sestupují do dermis. Lalůčky obsahují malé bazaloidní buňky s periferním palisádováním; část buněk diferencuje směrem k velkým eozinofilním keratinocytům. Je přítomna mírná cytologická atypie a ojedinělé mitózy. Jde o proliferující trichilemální nádor. Tyto nádory byly tradičně považovány za hraniční, v aktuální klasifikaci WHO jsou však řazeny mezi low-grade maligní léze. Mohou být lokálně agresivní, metastazování je velmi vzácné.

cases.comment_source: The slide consists of skin which shows a septal panniculitis. Focal aggregations of multinucleated foreign body giant cells are noted in association with epithelioid macrophages resulting in granuloma formation. Minimal chronic inflammation is seen in the lobules. This is erythema nodosum. Panniculitis refers to inflammation in the subcutaneous fat. Septal panniculitis is thus inflammation of the septae located between fat lobules. Erythema nodosum results in painful red nodules of the shins, commonly as a result of contraceptive pill and other drug use or inflammatory bowel disease.

cases.comment_cs: Kůže vykazuje septální panikulitidu. Ložiskově jsou shluky mnohojaderných obrovských buněk typu cizího tělesa s epiteloidními makrofágy a tvorbou granulomů. V tukových lalůčcích je minimální chronický zánět. Jde o erythema nodosum. Panikulitida znamená zánět podkožního tuku; septální panikulitida postihuje septa mezi tukovými lalůčky. Erythema nodosum se projevuje bolestivými červenými uzly na bércích a může souviset například s hormonální antikoncepcí, jinými léky či idiopatickými střevními záněty.

cases.comment_source: Skin which shows subtle acathosis. Underlying this, the dermis shows dense collagenization with scattered fibroblasts, capillary channels and histiocytes contained within. This is an atrophic dermatofibroma. An atrophic dermatofibroma simply refers to fact that the epidermis overlying the dermal lesion is not hyperplastic but slightly atrophic.

cases.comment_cs: Kůže vykazuje diskrétní akantózu. V dermis pod ní je denzní kolagenizace s roztroušenými fibroblasty, kapilárami a histiocyty. Jde o atrofický dermatofibrom. U atrofického dermatofibromu není epidermis nad dermální lézí hyperplastická, ale naopak lehce atrofická.

cases.comment_source: Two slides for you, both of which show levels of a skin punch biopsy. Within the epidermis, focal acantholysis is seen to form small clefts. Dermal papillae lined by basal cells are seen to protrude into these clefts in a villi-like manner. Dyskeratotic cells are also noted. The histological pattern is of acantholytic dyskeratosis. In view of the clinical history, Darrier's disease was the preferred diagnosis. Differentials clearly include other disorders that show dyskeratotic acantholysis including transient acantholytic dermatosis, warty dyskeratoma and Hailey-Hailey disease.

cases.comment_cs: Oba preparáty představují úrovně z punch biopsie kůže. V epidermis je ložisková akantolýza s tvorbou drobných štěrbin. Dermální papily vystlané bazálními buňkami vybíhají do štěrbin klkovitě. Přítomny jsou i dyskeratotické buňky. Histologický obraz odpovídá akantolytické dyskeratóze. Vzhledem ke klinické anamnéze byla preferována Darierova choroba. Diferenciálně přicházejí v úvahu další jednotky s dyskeratotickou akantolýzou, například tranzitorní akantolytická dermatóza, verukózní dyskeratom a Haileyova-Haileyova choroba.

cases.comment_source: Here we have a cut section of skin in which a well-defined lobulated dermal lesion is seen. The lesion is heterogenous, containing plentiful basaloid epitheloid cells and so-called 'ghost cells'. A foreign body giant cell reaction is noted as is calcification. This is a pilomatrixoma, a lesion also known as a pilomatricoma or a calcifying epithelioma of Malherbe! These are relatively common follicular neoplasms that often occur on the head and neck of children and, less commonly, in adults of any age.

cases.comment_cs: V řezu kůže je dobře ohraničená lobulární dermální léze. Je heterogenní, s četnými bazaloidními epiteloidními buňkami a tzv. „ghost cells“. Přítomna je obrovskobuněčná reakce typu cizího tělesa a kalcifikace. Jde o pilomatrixom, známý také jako pilomatrikom či kalcifikující epiteliom Malherbeho. Jde o poměrně častý folikulární nádor, typicky v oblasti hlavy a krku u dětí, méně často u dospělých.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows a lesion that consists of circumscribed basaloid tumour islands embedded within a loose stromal background. Peripheral palisading is noted and horn cysts are just discernible in the out of focus area. This is a trichoepithelioma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Trichoepithelioma PubMed Comment: This slide shows a lesion that consists of circumscribed basaloid tumour islands embedded within a loose stromal background. Peripheral palisading is noted and horn cysts are just discernible in the out of focus area. This is a trichoepithelioma.
cases.comment_cs: Léze je tvořena ohraničenými bazaloidními nádorovými ostrůvky v řídkém stromatu. Je patrné periferní palisádování a v méně zaostřené části lze rozeznat rohové cysty. Jde o trichoepiteliom.

cases.comment_source: A nice easy one! Polypoid skin fragment in which, focally, keratinocytes are seen to contain intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies. This is molluscum contagiosum.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Molluscum contagiosum PubMed Comment: A nice easy one! Polypoid skin fragment in which, focally, keratinocytes are seen to contain intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies. This is molluscum contagiosum.
cases.comment_cs: Jednoduchý případ: polypoidní fragment kůže, v němž keratinocyty ložiskově obsahují intracytoplazmatické inkluze. Jde o molluscum contagiosum.

cases.comment_source: This bit of skin shows a circumscribed melanocytic lesion in which junctional activity is seen to consist of nests / single melanocytes, some of which extend down elongated Rete ridges. Bridging is noted as is papillary dermal fibrosis. This is dysplastic naevus.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Mildly dysplastic naevus PubMed Comment: This bit of skin shows a circumscribed melanocytic lesion in which junctional activity is seen to consist of nests / single melanocytes, some of which extend down elongated Rete ridges. Bridging is noted as is papillary dermal fibrosis. This is dysplastic naevus.
cases.comment_cs: Ohraničená melanocytární léze vykazuje junkční aktivitu tvořenou hnízdy i jednotlivými melanocyty, z nichž některé sestupují podél prodloužených rete ridges. Je přítomno přemosťování a papilární dermální fibróza. Jde o dysplastický névus.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows tissue in which numerous 'interlocking' tumour nodules are seen to be surrounded by a thickened basement membrane. The tumour lobules contain hyaline droplets composed of basement membrane material. There is a dual cell population which comprises of an outer layer of small cells surrounding an inner layer of thin cells. This is a cylindroma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Cylindroma PubMed Comment: This slide shows tissue in which numerous 'interlocking' tumour nodules are seen to be surrounded by a thickened basement membrane. The tumour lobules contain hyaline droplets composed of basement membrane material. There is a dual cell population which comprises of an outer layer of small cells surrounding an inner layer of thin cells. This is a cylindroma.
cases.comment_cs: Tkáň obsahuje četné vzájemně do sebe zapadající nádorové uzly obklopené ztluštělou bazální membránou. V lalůčcích jsou hyalinní kapénky z materiálu bazální membrány. Přítomna je dvojí populace buněk – vnější vrstva malých buněk a vnitřní vrstva světlejších buněk. Jde o cylindrom.

cases.clinical_source: ?metastatic squamous carcinoma left elbow. Patient had a right BKA for squamous carcinoma followed by stump metastasis, hind quarter amputation and radiotherapy. An area of ulceration within the amputation stump biopsied five months ago when no tumour was found, although subsequent bone biopsy did show infiltration by moderately differentiated squamous carcinoma. Specimen: Not specified. Macro: Pale fragments together 10x10mm.
cases.clinical_cs: ?Metastatický spinocelulární karcinom levého lokte. Pacient prodělal pravostrannou amputaci pod kolenem pro spinocelulární karcinom, následovala metastáza v pahýlu, hemipelvektomie a radioterapie. Oblast ulcerace v amputačním pahýlu byla bioptována před pěti měsíci bez průkazu nádoru, následná kostní biopsie však prokázala infiltraci středně diferencovaným spinocelulárním karcinomem. Vzorek neuveden. Makroskopicky bledé fragmenty dohromady 10 × 10 mm.

cases.clinical_source: Firm erythematous subcutaneous lesion on lower back. Previous DLE, limited cutaneous systematic sclerosis, HTLV 1 + 2. Specimen: Incision ellipse edge of lesion. Macro: Skin ellipse with underlying subcutaneous tissue measuring14x8x6mm the surface is unremarkable. Specimen is longitudinally bisected. cases.clinical_cs: Tuhá erytematózní podkožní léze v dolní části zad. V anamnéze DLE, limitovaná kožní systémová skleróza, HTLV-1/2 pozitivita. Vzorek: incizní elipsa z okraje léze. Makroskopicky kožní elipsa s podkožní tkání 14 × 8 × 6 mm, povrch bez nápadností; vzorek podélně půlen. Imunohistochemie: buňky pozitivní pro CD3, CD5 a CD25, velká část CD4 pozitivní. Negativní CD7, CD20, CD79a, ALK-1 a CD30. MIB-1 index vysoký.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows the classical appearances of a cylindroma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Cylindroma PubMed Comment: This slide shows the classical appearances of a cylindroma.
cases.comment_cs: Klasický obraz cylindromu.

cases.comment_source: The slide shows skin which contains nests of basaloid cells within the dermis and are connected to the epidermis. There is a degree of peripheral pallisading, stromal myxoid change and numerous apoptotic bodies / mitoses. This is a nodular basal cell carcinoma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Nodular basal cell carcinoma PubMed Comment: The slide shows skin which contains nests of basaloid cells within the dermis and are connected to the epidermis. There is a degree of peripheral pallisading, stromal myxoid change and numerous apoptotic bodies / mitoses. This is a nodular basal cell carcinoma.
cases.comment_cs: Kůže obsahuje v dermis hnízda bazaloidních buněk napojená na epidermis. Je přítomno periferní palisádování, myxoidní změny stromatu a četná apoptotická tělíska/mitózy. Jde o nodulární bazocelulární karcinom.

cases.comment_source: This section shows a well-circumscribed dermal neoplasm composed of multiple duct structures contained within a dense fibrotic stroma. The ducts appear bilayered and some have a characteristic 'tadpole' morphology. This is a syringoma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Syringoma PubMed Comment: This section shows a well-circumscribed dermal neoplasm composed of multiple duct structures contained within a dense fibrotic stroma. The ducts appear bilayered and some have a characteristic 'tadpole' morphology. This is a syringoma.
cases.comment_cs: Dobře ohraničená dermální neoplazie je tvořena četnými duktálními strukturami v denzním fibrózním stromatu. Dukty jsou dvojvrstevné a některé mají typickou morfologii „pulce“. Jde o syringom.

cases.comment_source: The skin in this slide contains a nodular lesion composed of numerous tumour nodules that display peripheral pallisading. The tumour lobules are encased within a dense tissue sheath and are surrounded by hyaline basement membrane-like material. Occasional papillary mesenchymal bodies are seen. This is a trichoblastoma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Trichoblastoma PubMed Comment: The skin in this slide contains a nodular lesion composed of numerous tumour nodules that display peripheral pallisading. The tumour lobules are encased within a dense tissue sheath and are surrounded by hyaline basement membrane-like material. Occasional papillary mesenchymal bodies are seen. This is a trichoblastoma.
cases.comment_cs: Nodulární léze v kůži je tvořena četnými nádorovými uzly s periferním palisádováním. Lalůčky jsou obaleny denzním vazivovým pouzdrem a obklopeny hyalinním materiálem podobným bazální membráně. Ojediněle jsou přítomna papilární mezenchymální tělíska. Jde o trichoblastom.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows skin containing an expansile dermal neoplasm. The tumour is composed of confluent lobules of small squamous cells that display focal ductal differentiation. Dermal collagen envelopes the tumour lobules. The cells lining the ducts show features of apocrine differentiation. This is an apocrine poroma. The scattered mitoses seen are typical. In this case, tumour extends to the margins.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Apocrine poroma PubMed Comment: This slide shows skin containing an expansile dermal neoplasm. The tumour is composed of confluent lobules of small squamous cells that display focal ductal differentiation. Dermal collagen envelopes the tumour lobules. The cells lining the ducts show features of apocrine differentiation. This is an apocrine poroma. The scattered mitoses seen are typical. In this case, tumour extends to the margins.
cases.comment_cs: Kůže obsahuje expanzivní dermální neoplazii tvořenou splývajícími lalůčky malých dlaždicových buněk s ložiskovou duktální diferenciací. Lalůčky jsou obklopeny dermálním kolagenem. Buňky vystýlající dukty vykazují apokrinní diferenciaci. Jde o apokrinní porom. Roztroušené mitózy jsou pro tuto lézi typické. Nádor v tomto případě zasahuje k okrajům.

cases.comment_source: Continuing the adnexal tumour theme, this slide shows several circumscribed basophilic nodules in the dermis and subcutis. The nodules are composed of both small, dark, basaloid cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and a second population of cells with large, pale, vesicular, and ovoid nuclei. Scattered lymphocytes are seen throughout. This is an eccrine spiradenoma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Eccrine spiradenoma PubMed Comment: Continuing the adnexal tumour theme, this slide shows several circumscribed basophilic nodules in the dermis and subcutis. The nodules are composed of both small, dark, basaloid cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and a second population of cells with large, pale, vesicular, and ovoid nuclei. Scattered lymphocytes are seen throughout. This is an eccrine spiradenoma.
cases.comment_cs: V dermis a podkoží je několik ohraničených bazofilních uzlů. Jsou tvořeny jednak malými tmavými bazaloidními buňkami s hyperchromními jádry, jednak druhou populací větších světlých buněk s vezikulárními oválnými jádry. V celé lézi jsou roztroušené lymfocyty. Jde o ekrinní spiradenom.

cases.comment_source: This skin shows normal epidermis overlying a dermal tumour composed of sheets of spindle cells arranged in a storiform pattern. Immunohistochemistry for CD34 (slide 2) shows diffuse positivity. The features are those of dermatofibrosarcoma protruberans.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Dermatofibromasarcoma protruberans PubMed Comment: This skin shows normal epidermis overlying a dermal tumour composed of sheets of spindle cells arranged in a storiform pattern. Immunohistochemistry for CD34 (slide 2) shows diffuse positivity. The features are those of dermatofibrosarcoma protruberans.
cases.category_cs: Mezenchymální, vaskulární, nervové a histiocytární léze
cases.comment_cs: Normální epidermis překrývá dermální nádor tvořený plochami vřetenitých buněk ve storiformním uspořádání. IHC pro CD34 (slide 2) je difuzně pozitivní. Nález odpovídá dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows hyper-parakeratotic, acanthotic skin. The dermis is scarred, hyalinised and contains lymphoplasmastic aggregates. There are abscesses in surrounding hairshafts. This is folliculitis keloidalis nuchae.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Folliculitis keloidalis nuchae PubMed Comment: This slide shows hyper-parakeratotic, acanthotic skin. The dermis is scarred, hyalinised and contains lymphoplasmastic aggregates. There are abscesses in surrounding hairshafts. This is folliculitis keloidalis nuchae.
cases.comment_cs: Hyperparakeratotická, akantotická kůže. Dermis je zjizvená, hyalinizovaná a obsahuje lymfoplazmocytární agregáty. V okolí vlasových stvolů jsou abscesy. Jde o folliculitis keloidalis nuchae.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows clonal Bowen's disease in which intra-epithelial nests of dysplastic keratinocytes can clearly be seen.

cases.diagnosis_group: Squamous cell carcinoma in situ (Bowen disease)
cases.comment_cs: Klonální Bowenova choroba s jasně patrnými intraepidermálními hnízdy dysplastických keratinocytů.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows skin in which a dermal tumour is seen to be composed of islands of basaloid cells. Interspersed within the islands are small duct-like spaces which contain mucoid material. The cell population is monotonous and minimal eosinophilic cytoplasm harbours large rounded nuclei. Occasional mitoses are seen. This is adenoid cystic carcinoma. The tumour cells were S100 and CK positive. The patient had a previous history of this disease.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Adenoid cystic carcinoma PubMed Comment: This slide shows skin in which a dermal tumour is seen to be composed of islands of basaloid cells. Interspersed within the islands are small duct-like spaces which contain mucoid material. The cell population is monotonous and minimal eosinophilic cytoplasm harbours large rounded nuclei. Occasional mitoses are seen. This is adenoid cystic carcinoma. The tumour cells were S100 and CK positive. The patient had a previous history of this disease.
cases.comment_cs: V dermis je nádor tvořený ostrůvky bazaloidních buněk. Mezi nimi jsou drobné duktální prostory s mukoidním materiálem. Buněčná populace je monotónní, s minimem eozinofilní cytoplazmy a velkými kulatými jádry. Ojedinělé mitózy jsou přítomny. Jde o adenoidně cystický karcinom. Nádorové buňky byly S100 a CK pozitivní. Pacient měl toto onemocnění již v anamnéze.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows sections from a circumscribed dermal lesion. The lesion is composed of multiple cellular elements including adipocytes, cartilage and eccrine cells arranged in a glandulo-cystic architecture. This is a cutaenous pleomorphic adenoma AKA mixed tumour of the skin. No evidence of malignancy is seen.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Cutaneous mixed tumour PubMed Comment: This slide shows sections from a circumscribed dermal lesion. The lesion is composed of multiple cellular elements including adipocytes, cartilage and eccrine cells arranged in a glandulo-cystic architecture. This is a cutaenous pleomorphic adenoma AKA mixed tumour of the skin. No evidence of malignancy is seen.
cases.comment_cs: Ohraničená dermální léze obsahuje více buněčných složek včetně adipocytů, chrupavky a ekrinních buněk uspořádaných v glandulocystické architektuře. Jde o kožní pleomorfní adenom, tedy smíšený nádor kůže. Bez známek malignity.

cases.comment_source: This section shows attenuated epidermis overlying a dermal lesion that extends from the papillary to the reticular layers of the dermal compartment. The lesion consists of a syncytial mass of cells that have a central, rounded, nuclei and minimal cytoplasm. The cells are positive for smooth muscle actin, cytokeratin and S100. This is a myoepithelioma, a benign skin adnexal tumour.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Myoepithelioma PubMed Comment: This section shows attenuated epidermis overlying a dermal lesion that extends from the papillary to the reticular layers of the dermal compartment. The lesion consists of a syncytial mass of cells that have a central, rounded, nuclei and minimal cytoplasm. The cells are positive for smooth muscle actin, cytokeratin and S100. This is a myoepithelioma, a benign skin adnexal tumour.
cases.category_cs: Mezenchymální, vaskulární, nervové a histiocytární léze
cases.comment_cs: Atrofická epidermis překrývá dermální lézi zasahující od papilární po retikulární dermis. Léze je tvořena syncytiální masou buněk s centrálními kulatými jádry a minimem cytoplazmy. Buňky jsou pozitivní pro SMA, cytokeratin a S100. Jde o myoepiteliom, benigní adnexální kožní nádor.

cases.comment_source: The first slide (H&E) shows hyper-parakeratotic epidermis in which a minor degree of epidermal spongiosis and lymphocytic exocytosis is also noted. The dermis shows a lichenoid inflammatory reaction which appears perivascular in some areas. Dermal sclerosis is also noted as is erythrocyte extravasation. Perls stain (second slide) confirms the presence of dermal haemosiderin. This is lichen aureus, an entity first described in 1958. Lichen aureus is a rare condition that is considered a member of the group of pigmented purpuric dermatoses.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Lichen aureus PubMed Comment: The first slide (H&E) shows hyper-parakeratotic epidermis in which a minor degree of epidermal spongiosis and lymphocytic exocytosis is also noted. The dermis shows a lichenoid inflammatory reaction which appears perivascular in some areas. Dermal sclerosis is also noted as is erythrocyte extravasation. Perls stain (second slide) confirms the presence of dermal haemosiderin. This is lichen aureus, an entity first described in 1958. Lichen aureus is a rare condition that is considered a member of the group of pigmented purpuric dermatoses.
cases.comment_cs: První preparát (H&E) ukazuje hyperparakeratotickou epidermis s mírnou spongiózou a lymfocytární exocytózou. V dermis je lichenoidní zánětlivá reakce, místy perivaskulární, dále skleróza a extravazace erytrocytů. Perlsovo barvení (druhý preparát) potvrzuje dermální hemosiderin. Jde o lichen aureus, vzácnou jednotku ze skupiny pigmentovaných purpurických dermatóz.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows skin in which a moderately dense superficial lymphocytic infiltrate is seen in association with a degree of exocytosis. The cells in the epidermis have a clear halo and irregular nuclear outlines. This is mycosis fungoides, a cutaneous T-cell lymphoma. The diagnosis was confirmed on molecular testing.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Mycosis fungoides PubMed Comment: This slide shows skin in which a moderately dense superficial lymphocytic infiltrate is seen in association with a degree of exocytosis. cases.comment_cs: V kůži je středně denzní povrchový lymfocytární infiltrát s exocytózou. Buňky v epidermis mají světlé halo a nepravidelné kontury jader. Jde o mycosis fungoides, kožní T-buněčný lymfom. Diagnóza byla potvrzena molekulárním vyšetřením.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows an infiltrative tumour composed of lobules / sheets of uniform but atypical cells that are seen to extend throughout the dermis. Although features of squamous cell carcinoma are seen, ductal differentiation is also noted. This is, therefore, an eccrine porocarcinoma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Eccrine porocarcinoma PubMed Comment: This slide shows an infiltrative tumour composed of lobules / sheets of uniform but atypical cells that are seen to extend throughout the dermis. Although features of squamous cell carcinoma are seen, ductal differentiation is also noted. This is, therefore, an eccrine porocarcinoma.
cases.comment_cs: Infiltrativní nádor je tvořen lalůčky/plochami uniformních, ale atypických buněk zasahujících celou dermis. Vedle znaků spinocelulárního karcinomu je přítomna také duktální diferenciace. Jde tedy o ekrinní porokarcinom.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows sun-damaged skin in which a dermal tumour is seen to be composed of highly atypical spindled / multinucleated tumour cells. The cells are arranged in ill-defined fascicles and show brisk mitotic activity. This is an atypical fibroxanthoma. Immunohistochemistry was positive for SMA and CD10 and negative for pancytokeratin, CK5/6, CK14, EMA, p63, S100, HMB45, MelanA and desmin. The overlying epidermis contains multiple foci of mild to moderately atypical actinic keratoses.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Atypical fibroxanthoma PubMed Comment: This slide shows sun-damaged skin in which a dermal tumour is seen to be composed of highly atypical spindled / multinucleated tumour cells. The cells are arranged in ill-defined fascicles and show brisk mitotic activity. This is an atypical fibroxanthoma. Immunohistochemistry was positive for SMA and CD10 and negative for pancytokeratin, CK5/6, CK14, EMA, p63, S100, HMB45, MelanA and desmin. The overlying epidermis contains multiple foci of mild to moderately atypical actinic keratoses.
cases.category_cs: Mezenchymální, vaskulární, nervové a histiocytární léze
cases.comment_cs: Sluncem poškozená kůže obsahuje dermální nádor tvořený výrazně atypickými vřetenitými a mnohojadernými nádorovými buňkami v neostře uspořádaných fasciklech s vysokou mitotickou aktivitou. Jde o atypický fibroxantom. IHC: SMA a CD10 pozitivní; pancytokeratin, CK5/6, CK14, EMA, p63, S100, HMB45, Melan-A a desmin negativní. V epidermis je více ložisek mírně až středně atypické aktinické keratózy.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows a section from the ear in which epidermis is seen to become hyperkeratotic and, in turn, ulcerated. The epidermal ulceration overlies a circumscribed, intra-dermal lesion, which contains needle-shaped crystals (visible on polarisation only). This is a perforating gouty tophus.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Gouty tophus PubMed Comment: This slide shows a section from the ear in which epidermis is seen to become hyperkeratotic and, in turn, ulcerated. The epidermal ulceration overlies a circumscribed, intra-dermal lesion, which contains needle-shaped crystals (visible on polarisation only). This is a perforating gouty tophus.

cases.comment_cs: Řez z ucha ukazuje hyperkeratotickou a následně ulcerovanou epidermis. Ulcerace překrývá ohraničenou intradermální lézi s jehlicovitými krystaly patrnými pouze v polarizaci. Jde o perforující dnavý tofus.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows a dermal spindle-cell tumour that extends into sub-cutaneous adipose tissue. The spindle cells are plump, arranged in a storiform pattern, and are of variable cellularity throughout the lesion. At the edge of the lesion, the spindle cells are seen to wrap around collagen bundles. The overlying epidermis shows reactive epidermal hyperplasia. This is a cellular dermatofibroma, a lesion that often causes diagnostic confusion with dermatofibrosarcoma protruberans.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Cellular dermatofibroma PubMed Comment: This slide shows a dermal spindle-cell tumour that extends into sub-cutaneous adipose tissue. The spindle cells are plump, arranged in a storiform pattern, and are of variable cellularity throughout the lesion. At the edge of the lesion, the spindle cells are seen to wrap around collagen bundles. The overlying epidermis shows reactive epidermal hyperplasia. This is a cellular dermatofibroma, a lesion that often causes diagnostic confusion with dermatofibrosarcoma protruberans.
cases.category_cs: Mezenchymální, vaskulární, nervové a histiocytární léze
cases.comment_cs: Dermální vřetenobuněčný nádor zasahuje do podkožní tukové tkáně. Vřetenité buňky jsou robustní, ve storiformním uspořádání a s proměnlivou celularitou. Na periferii léze obalují kolagenní svazky. Nadložní epidermis vykazuje reaktivní hyperplazii. Jde o celulární dermatofibrom, který může diagnosticky napodobovat dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows skin in which a nodular dermal lesion is seen to be composed of spindle cells and slit-like vascular spaces. The tumour was positive for HHV8. This is Kaposi sarcoma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Kaposi sarcoma PubMed Comment: This slide shows skin in which a nodular dermal lesion is seen to be composed of spindle cells and slit-like vascular spaces. The tumour was positive for HHV8. This is Kaposi sarcoma.
cases.category_cs: Mezenchymální, vaskulární, nervové a histiocytární léze

cases.comment_source: This slide shows levels from a punch biopsy in which a diffuse dermal necrobiotic lesion is surrounded by palisading fibrohistiocytic cells and scattered giant cells. The lesion extends from the deep dermis into the papillary dermis. The features are those of necrobiosis lipoidica diabeticorum.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Necrobiosis lipoidica diabeticorum PubMed Comment: This slide shows levels from a punch biopsy in which a diffuse dermal necrobiotic lesion is surrounded by palisading fibrohistiocytic cells and scattered giant cells. cases.comment_cs: V úrovních punch biopsie je difuzní dermální nekrobiotická léze obklopená palisádovitě uspořádanými fibrohistiocytárními buňkami a roztroušenými obrovskými buňkami. Léze zasahuje z hluboké do papilární dermis. Nález odpovídá necrobiosis lipoidica diabeticorum.

cases.clinical_source: Blistering condition for 2 months. All over body.

cases.comment_source: This skin biopsy shows abnormal elastic fibres of the reticular dermis. The abnormal fibres are thickened, fragmented and have an irregular profile. Focal calcium deposition is noted on the Von Kossa stain. This is pseudoxanthoma elasticum. This disease, also known as Grönblad-Strandberg syndrome, represents a genetic disease that results in abnormal fragmentation / mineralization of elastic fibres in certain tissues. The skin and eyes are commonly affected.

The abnormal fibres are thickened, fragmented and have an irregular profile. Focal calcium deposition is noted on the Von Kossa stain. This is pseudoxanthoma elasticum. This disease, also known as Grönblad-Strandberg syndrome, represents a genetic disease that results in abnormal fragmentation / mineralization of elastic fibres in certain tissues. The skin and eyes are commonly affected.

Jde o pseudoxanthoma elasticum. Toto genetické onemocnění, známé také jako Grönblad-Strandbergův syndrom, vede k abnormální fragmentaci a mineralizaci elastických vláken; často postihuje kůži a oči.

Immunohistochemistry for HHV8 (shown here) confirms the diagnosis.

cases.clinical_source: Punch biopsy from the right leg
cases.comment_source: This punch biopsy shows skin in which irregularly acanthotic / hyperkeratotic epidermis overlies focally inflamed dermis. At the dermo-epidermal junction, chronic inflammatory cells are seen in a patchy, discontinuous, distribution with a relative concentration of cells at the base of rete ridges. In these areas the features are focally reminiscent of lichen planus. The surrounding dermis is somewhat sclerotic but otherwise unremarkable. This is the chronic / end-stage morphology of lichen planus.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Lichen planus (end-stage) PubMed Comment: This punch biopsy shows skin in which irregularly acanthotic / hyperkeratotic epidermis overlies focally inflamed dermis. At the dermo-epidermal junction, chronic inflammatory cells are seen in a patchy, discontinuous, distribution with a relative concentration of cells at the base of rete ridges. In these areas the features are focally reminiscent of lichen planus. The surrounding dermis is somewhat sclerotic but otherwise unremarkable. This is the chronic / end-stage morphology of lichen planus.
cases.clinical_cs: Punch biopsie z pravé dolní končetiny
cases.comment_cs: Nepravidelně akantotická/hyperkeratotická epidermis překrývá ložiskově zanícenou dermis. Na dermoepidermální junkci jsou chronické zánětlivé buňky v nesouvislé ložiskové distribuci, s relativní koncentrací při bázi rete ridges; místy obraz připomíná lichen planus. Okolní dermis je mírně sklerotická. Jde o chronickou/terminální morfologii lichen planus.

cases.clinical_source: Lump on back. Previous sun exposure.
cases.comment_source: This virtual slide shows a circumscribed dermal lesion composed of bundles of hyalinized collagen separated by artefactual clefts with a storiform pattern. This is a storiform collagenoma. This lesion, regarded as a solitary form of sclerosing fibroma, is characterized by the presence of dense collagen deposition in a markedly hypocellular but well-circumscribed lesion. Expression of CD34 (not shown here) is typical. It is suggested some cases represent the end stage of a folliculitic process.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Storiform collagenoma PubMed Comment: This virtual slide shows a circumscribed dermal lesion composed of bundles of hyalinized collagen separated by artefactual clefts with a storiform pattern. Expression of CD34 (not shown here) is typical. It is suggested some cases represent the end stage of a folliculitic process.

Jde o storiformní kolagenom, solitární formu sklerotizujícího fibromu, charakterizovanou denzním ukládáním kolagenu v výrazně hypocelulární, dobře ohraničené lézi. Typická je exprese CD34. Některé případy mohou představovat konečné stadium folikulitického procesu.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows skin in which a crater-like lesion consists of epidermis in which supra-basal acantholysis is seen in association with dyskeratosis. This is a warty dyskeratoma. Also known as isolated follicular keratosis, warty dyskeratoma usually occurs on sun-exposed skin. The lesion, characterised microscopically by follicular acantholysis and dyskeratosis, is possibly a primary proliferative process of hair follicles.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Warty dyskeratoma PubMed Comment: This slide shows skin in which a crater-like lesion consists of epidermis in which supra-basal acantholysis is seen in association with dyskeratosis. This is a warty dyskeratoma. Also known as isolated follicular keratosis, warty dyskeratoma usually occurs on sun-exposed skin. The lesion, characterised microscopically by follicular acantholysis and dyskeratosis, is possibly a primary proliferative process of hair follicles.
cases.comment_cs: Kráteriformní léze epidermis vykazuje suprabazální akantolýzu spojenou s dyskeratózou. Jde o verukózní dyskeratom, známý také jako izolovaná folikulární keratóza. Obvykle vzniká na slunci exponované kůži a mikroskopicky je charakterizován folikulární akantolýzou a dyskeratózou; může jít o primární proliferační proces vlasového folikulu.

cases.comment_source: This is skin in which an ill-defined dermal lesion is seen to be composed of interlacing fascicles of mild to moderately atypical spindle cells. The cells have an eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated nuclei with blunt ends. Two mitoses are counted per ten high powered fields. There is no necrosis. A patchy lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate in the background. The tumour cells were positive for desmin and SMA (not shown). They were negative for AE1/3, HMB45, S100 and CD34. This is a pilar leiomyosarcoma. The lesion is grade 1 by application of the FNCLCC criteria (differention=1, mitoses=1, necrosis=0).

There is a decrease in cell and nest size with descent into the dermis. No dermal mitotic figures are seen. This is a benign intradermal melanocytic naevus.
cases.comment_cs: Polypoidní léze obsahuje v dermis hnízda melanocytů, jejichž velikost i velikost hnízd se směrem do hloubky zmenšuje. Dermální mitózy nejsou patrné. Jde o benigní intradermální melanocytární névus.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows a well-demarcated spindle lesion which arises from or adjacent to the wall and lumen of a large blood vessel. The lesion is composed of interlacing fascicles of cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and cigar-shaped nuclei. The cells display marked nuclear pleomorphism and numerous mitoses(28/10 HPF) are noted, some of which include atypical forms. Focal necrosis involving less than 50% of the tumour is seen. Immunohistochemistry (not shown) displayed strong staining for SMA, desmin and H- Caldesmon. Pan- cytokeratin, S100 and CD34 were negative. This is a leiomyosarcoma. According to the FNLCC criteria this tumour is a grade 3 sarcoma (differentiation 2, mitoses 3, necrosis 1).

cases.comment_cs: Dobře ohraničená vřetenobuněčná léze vyrůstá ze stěny či v blízkosti stěny a lumen velké cévy. Je tvořena proplétajícími se fascikly buněk s hojnou eozinofilní cytoplazmou a doutníkovitými jádry. Buňky vykazují výrazný jaderný pleomorfismus a četné mitózy (28/10 HPF), včetně atypických. Ložisková nekróza postihuje méně než 50 % nádoru. IHC: silně pozitivní SMA, desmin a h-caldesmon; pancytokeratin, S100 a CD34 negativní. Jde o leiomyosarkom, grade 3 dle FNCLCC (diferenciace 2, mitózy 3, nekróza 1).

cases.comment_source: This slide shows skin in which a central, ill defined dermal lesion is seen. The lesion is composed of histiocytes of variable appearance : the majority are foamy but some angulated forms are also present. Touton giant cells are seen throughout as are a scattering of eosinophils. This is a benign xanthogranuloma. Immunohistochemistry confirmed the cells as histiocytic.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Xanthogranuloma PubMed Comment: This slide shows skin in which a central, ill defined dermal lesion is seen. The lesion is composed of histiocytes of variable appearance : the majority are foamy but some angulated forms are also present. cases.comment_cs: Centrální neostře ohraničená dermální léze je tvořena histiocyty různého vzhledu, převážně pěnitými, místy angulovanými. V celé lézi jsou Toutonovy obrovské buňky a roztroušené eozinofily. Jde o benigní xantogranulom. IHC potvrdila histiocytární charakter buněk.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows sections of skin and subcutaneous fat which contain an ill defined infiltrative tumour. The tumour is composed of angular vascular channels lined by cells with highly pleomorphic nuclei, prominent nucleoli and focal multilayering. Mitoses are seen throughout. The lesion is located in the deep dermis, and infiltrates widely along the deep aspect of the dermal collagen. This is a high-grade angiosarcoma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Angiosarcoma PubMed Comment: This slide shows sections of skin and subcutaneous fat which contain an ill defined infiltrative tumour. The tumour is composed of angular vascular channels lined by cells with highly pleomorphic nuclei, prominent nucleoli and focal multilayering. Mitoses are seen throughout. The lesion is located in the deep dermis, and infiltrates widely along the deep aspect of the dermal collagen. This is a high-grade angiosarcoma.

cases.comment_cs: Řezy kůže a podkožního tuku obsahují neostře ohraničený infiltrativní nádor tvořený angulárními cévními kanály vystlanými buňkami s výrazně pleomorfními jádry, nápadnými jadérky a ložiskovým vrstvením. Mitózy jsou četné. Léze je v hluboké dermis a široce infiltruje podél hluboké části dermálního kolagenu. Jde o high-grade angiosarkom.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows skin in which abundant dermal collagen bears an indistinct spindle cell population. The spindle cells and associated stroma appear to infiltrate into the sub-cutaneous fat. Prominant lymphocytic proliferation is manefested by multiple poorly formed follicles. The overlying epidermis shows some melanocytic abnormalities. Immunohistochemistry for S100 (shown here) demonstrates the spindle cell population. This is desmoplastic melanoma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Desmoplastic malignant melanoma PubMed Comment: This slide shows skin in which abundant dermal collagen bears an indistinct spindle cell population. The spindle cells and associated stroma appear to infiltrate into the sub-cutaneous fat. Prominant lymphocytic proliferation is manefested by multiple poorly formed follicles. The overlying epidermis shows some melanocytic abnormalities. Immunohistochemistry for S100 (shown here) demonstrates the spindle cell population. This is desmoplastic melanoma.
cases.comment_cs: V hojně kolagenní dermis je nevýrazná populace vřetenitých buněk se stromatem infiltrujícím podkožní tuk. Výrazná lymfocytární proliferace se projevuje více špatně formovanými folikuly. Nadložní epidermis vykazuje melanocytární abnormality. IHC S100 zvýrazňuje vřetenobuněčnou populaci. Jde o desmoplastický melanom.

cases.comment_source: This slide shows skin in which a lesion is seen to extend from the papillary dermis into the subcutaneous fat. The lesion is composed of an admixture of cells; there are large cells with abundant cytoplasm and central oval nuclei. Many have vacuolated cytoplasm. Multinucleate forms are also identified. There is a lymphocytic and neutrophilic infiltrate. Abscess formation is noted. The overlying epidermis shows marked pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia. Special stains for fungi (not shown) revealed numerous intracytoplasmic yeast-like forms. The appearances are those of an inflammatory / infective process which likely represents fungal infection.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Fungal infection PubMed Comment: This slide shows skin in which a lesion is seen to extend from the papillary dermis into the subcutaneous fat. The lesion is composed of an admixture of cells; there are large cells with abundant cytoplasm and central oval nuclei. Many have vacuolated cytoplasm. Multinucleate forms are also identified. There is a lymphocytic and neutrophilic infiltrate. Abscess formation is noted. The overlying epidermis shows marked pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia. Special stains for fungi (not shown) revealed numerous intracytoplasmic yeast-like forms. The appearances are those of an inflammatory / infective process which likely represents fungal infection.
cases.comment_cs: Léze zasahuje z papilární dermis do podkožního tuku a tvoří ji směs buněk, včetně velkých buněk s hojnou cytoplazmou a centrálními oválnými jádry; řada buněk má vakuolizovanou cytoplazmu a přítomny jsou i mnohojaderné formy. Je přítomen lymfocytární a neutrofilní infiltrát s tvorbou abscesů. Epidermis vykazuje výraznou pseudoepiteliomatózní hyperplazii. Speciální barvení na houby prokázalo četné intracytoplazmatické kvasinkovité formy. Obraz odpovídá zánětlivému/infekčnímu procesu, pravděpodobně mykotické infekci.

cases.diagnosis_source: Nodular basal cell carcinoma with adjacent benign hair follicle elements
cases.comment_source: These sections of skin clearly show a nodular basal cell carcinoma in which there is no evidence of perineural invasion. Immediately adjacent to the main lesion are small lobulated aggregates of basaloid cells indispersed with sebaceous cells. These cells have considerably smaller nuclei than the adjacent basal cell carcinoma. These areas are benign and most likely represent areas of immature sebaceous gland tissue (follicular mantel) or hamartoma. Immunohistochemistry (not shown)confirmed this with the tumour being Ber-Ep4 positive. The benign tissue elements adjacent were Ber-Ep4 negative.

cases.comment_cs: Řezy jasně ukazují nodulární bazocelulární karcinom bez perineurální invaze. Těsně vedle hlavní léze jsou malé lobulární agregáty bazaloidních buněk promíšených se sebocyty; mají výrazně menší jádra než buňky BCC. Tyto oblasti jsou benigní a pravděpodobně představují nezralou sebaceózní tkáň (folikulární plášť) či hamartom. IHC: nádor BerEP4 pozitivní, přilehlé benigní elementy BerEP4 negativní.

cases.comment_source: This section of skin shows an endophytic lesion in continuation with papillomatous squamous epidermis. The lesion is composed of uniform, varying sized lobules of squamoid cells with occasional scattered ducts, interspersed with inflamed fibrous tissue. This is an eccrine poroma.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Eccrine poroma PubMed Comment: This section of skin shows an endophytic lesion in continuation with papillomatous squamous epidermis. The lesion is composed of uniform, varying sized lobules of squamoid cells with occasional scattered ducts, interspersed with inflamed fibrous tissue. This is an eccrine poroma.
cases.comment_cs: Endofytická léze navazuje na papilomatózní dlaždicovou epidermis. Je tvořena uniformními, různě velkými lalůčky skvamózních buněk s ojedinělými dukty, oddělenými zaníceným fibrózním stromatem. Jde o ekrinní porom.

cases.comment_source: This skin punch biopsy shows normal epidermis overlying dermis in which a perivascular and interstitial histiocytic infiltrate is seen. Additionally, multinucleated giant cells, some of Touton type, and lymphocytes are also noted. Some of the giant cells show asteroid bodies in their cytoplasm. No well-formed granulomas are evident. There is no evidence of vasculitis or small vessel thrombosis. Overall the features are of a xanthogranuloma.

Additionally, multinucleated giant cells, some of Touton type, and lymphocytes are also noted. Some of the giant cells show asteroid bodies in their cytoplasm. No well-formed granulomas are evident. There is no evidence of vasculitis or small vessel thrombosis. Overall the features are of a xanthogranuloma.

Dále jsou přítomny mnohojaderné obrovské buňky, některé Toutonova typu, a lymfocyty; v některých obrovských buňkách jsou asteroidní tělíska. Dobře formované granulomy nejsou přítomny, stejně jako známky vaskulitidy či trombózy drobných cév. Celkový obraz odpovídá xantogranulomu.

cases.comment_source: Average 2.9/5 This case was chosen as a good example of a granulomatous skin lesion, testing the approach of candidates to necrobiotic granulomatous skin lesions. Candidates were provided with a helpful clinical history. Pass marks were given to those who correctly identified the main abnormality as a necrobiotic granulomatous skin lesion and gave a reasonable differential diagnosis to include granuloma annulare, rheumatoid nodule and necrobiosis lipoidica. Candidates with a more confident approach and able to make a definite diagnosis of granuloma annulare were given additional marks, as were candidates offering clinicopathological correlation and aware of the different forms of granuloma annulare. Candidates who recognised a granulomatous condition, but failed to note the necrobiotic component, were given a borderline fail. Candidates who did not recognise the granulomatous nature of this condition, or who clearly favoured leprosy or other tropical/ infective disorders were given a clear fail, as were candidates who considered malignant diagnoses. This question was well answered by most candidates, with many candidates adding considerable value to their answers. A minority of candidates failed to recognise the necrobiotic component, or made confident diagnoses of tropical diseases such as leprosy.

cases.diagnosis_source: Pigmented spindle cell naevus of Reed
cases.comment_source: Average: 2.6/5 This was a relatively straightforward case, aiming to test the ability of candidates to report an unusual but well recognised melanocytic lesion, and arrive at a confident benign diagnosis. Pass marks were awarded to candidates giving a competent description of the lesion and clearly favouring a diagnosis of pigmented spindle cell tumour of Reed (Spitz naevus was also accepted). Additional marks were awarded to candidates able to give a particularly good description of the lesion, commenting on the need for complete excision, or noting that the patient is older than usual for this diagnosis. Candidates lost marks for equivocating between benign and malignant diagnoses, or arriving at clearly malignant diagnoses. The majority of candidates were able to pass this question, but because of the nature of the lesion it was difficult to add much value to answers. Only a few candidates failed by offering equivocal or malignant diagnoses.

cases.comment_source: Average: 2.7/5 This case was selected to assess the ability of candidates to interpret non-neoplastic skin disease and consider infective aetiology. Candidates were provided with a helpful and relevant history. In the opinion of examiners this was a good example of Leishmaniasis, with clearly visible organisms. Candidates had to look at all of the material to be sure of seeing the organisms, which were not visible in all of the slices. This is a reminder to candidates to look at all of the material provided on the slide. Pass marks were awarded to candidates giving a good basic description, including the observation of histiocytes distended by micro-organisms. To gain a pass candidates had to see micro-organisms and recognise infective aetiology, without necessarily diagnosing Leishmaniasis. Higher marks were awarded to candidates favouring a diagnosis of Leishmaniasis and indicating the need for Giemsa stain. Further marks were awarded to candidates able to add value by indicating knowledge of the natural history of Leishmaniasis, making appropriate clinical correlation with the history and indicating awareness of serological and molecular testing. Borderline fails were awarded to candidates arriving at benign non-infective diagnoses. A fail mark would have been awarded to any candidate giving a malignant diagnosis. Only a few candidates failed to appreciate the infective aetology of the lesions. This question was answered well by most candidates. Most candidates correctly identified micro-organisms, and a good proportion of candidates added value by correctly diagnosing Leishmaniasis. Only a few candidates mentioned the value of Giemsa stain or other ancillary tests.

cases.comment_source: Average 2.46/5 This case was selected as an example of a clinically unexpected malignant melanoma, as can be encountered by any pathologist in routine practice. The case assessed the ability of candidates to diagnose and stage malignant melanoma, or initiate investigations to make an appropriate diagnosis. There was no appreciable intraepidermal component in the sections, and the lesion was minimally pigmented. Pass marks were awarded to candidates confident to make a diagnosis of malignant melanoma on histological grounds alone, or favour melanoma in a differential diagnosis. Candidates who indicated the need for immunohistochemical investigations to confirm the differential diagnosis were also awarded a pass mark, provided that the immunohistochemical panel considered the possibility of melanoma. Additional markers were awarded to candidates adding value by offering appropriate staging information (Clark level and Breslow thickness), comment on growth phase (vertical), staging, mitotic count, lack of intra-epidermal component hence the need to consider metastasis, appropriate subtyping as nodular melanoma, or awareness of the relevance of BRAF immunohistochemical staining in order to consider chemoresponsiveness. Other relevant added value was also considered on its merits. Borderline fail marks were given to candidates giving a broad differential diagnosis including but not favouring melanoma. Fail marks were awarded to candidates offering benign diagnoses, or confident diagnoses of other malignancies, without considering melanoma. This case was answered variably by candidates. The majority of candidates gained pass marks by indicating the possibility of melanoma, supplemented by appropriate immunohistochemical stains. There were a few very good answers with considerable added value. A few answers were awarded borderline fails, by favouring other differential diagnoses, but suggesting appropriate immunohistochemical stains to consider melanoma. Only a few candidates made egregious errors, favouring inappropriate lesions.

cases.comment_source: Average score 2.59/5 This case was chosen as a good example of a relatively common melanocytic lesion that any pathologist might encounter in routine practice. The great majority of candidates passed this case with only a small proportion making erroneous malignant diagnoses. Malignant diagnoses were awarded a clear fail and candidates lacking confidence by offering broad differential diagnoses or noting the presence of atypia were given borderline fails. To pass a candidate had to describe a pigmented and benign junctional naevus. Additional marks were given to candidates correctly identifying a pigmented naevus of Reed (or a Spitz naevus) and making clinical correlations with the age of the patient. This was a relatively simple case and it was difficult for candidates to score very high marks by adding value.

cases.comment_source: Average score 2.34/5 This case is from district general hospital practice and was submitted by a general practitioner. It is a good example of a lesion seen by many pathologists as part of day-to-day practice, and should not have caused any problem to candidates with good routine reporting experience. Less than half of the candidates achieved pass marks for this case. Candidates lacked a holistic approach to the case, and did not identify organising thrombus in this case, or appreciate the reactive nature of the process. Many candidates favoured neoplastic lesions, and a small minority overcalled the lesion as Kaposi's sarcoma. The majority of candidates preferred benign neoplastic diagnoses. To gain a pass mark candidates were expected to correctly describe the process of organising thrombosis, but not name the lesion as IVPEH or "Masson's tumour". Additional marks were awarded to candidates able to name the lesion and comment on the (non-neoplastic) process. Borderline fails were given for diagnosis of benign vascular neoplasms, and clear fails were given to candidates making malignant diagnoses.

cases.comment_source: Average score 2.73/5 marks This case was chosen as a good example of a blistering skin disorder. Candidates were assessed on their ability to arrive at a diagnosis and suggest appropriate immunofluorescent stains. Most candidates answered this question well and arrived the correct diagnosis of bullous pemphigoid: many added value by indicating the need for appropriate immunohistochemical stains. Some candidates failed to recognise the presence of eosinophils and favoured other less appropriate blistering disorders. To pass candidates were expected to assess correctly the nature of the vesicle, comment on the presence of eosinophils and favour a diagnosis of bullous pemphigoid, as well as indicating the need for immunofluorescent studies. Additional marks were given to candidates able to make specific recommendations as to appropriate immunohistochemistry, comment on look-alike lesions and comment on the pathogenesis of bullous pemphigoid. Borderline fails were given to candidates offering differential diagnoses including but not favouring bullous pemphigoid, or omitting to mention the need for immunofluorecent staining.

cases.comment_source: Desmoplastic trichoepithelioma are benign adnexal lesions which are, perhaps unsurprisingly, considered a variant of trichoepithelioma. They usually occurs on the face, show a predilection for young adults and females, and typically present as sub-centimeter solitary firm lesions. The tumours are usually dermal, well-circumscribed and are composed of nests and cords of basaloid cells with surrounding dense hypocellular stroma. Distinction from the major differential diagnoses such as syringoma, infiltrative basal cell carcinoma and microcystic adnexal carcinoma can be challenging.

They usually occurs on the face, show a predilection for young adults and females, and typically present as sub-centimeter solitary firm lesions. The tumours are usually dermal, well-circumscribed and are composed of nests and cords of basaloid cells with surrounding dense hypocellular stroma. Distinction from the major differential diagnoses such as syringoma, infiltrative basal cell carcinoma and microcystic adnexal carcinoma can be challenging.
cases.comment_cs: Desmoplastický trichoepiteliom je benigní adnexální léze považovaná za variantu trichoepiteliomu. Obvykle vzniká na obličeji, častěji u mladých dospělých a žen, typicky jako solitární tuhý útvar menší než 1 cm. Nádor bývá dermální, dobře ohraničený a tvořený hnízdy a pruhy bazaloidních buněk obklopenými denzním hypocelulárním stromatem. Odlišení od hlavních diferenciálních diagnóz, jako jsou syringom, infiltrativní bazocelulární karcinom a mikrocystický adnexální karcinom, může být obtížné.

cases.comment_cs: Kůže vykazuje mírnou hyperkeratózu. V horní dermis je lymfoidní infiltrát tvořený převážně CD4+ T-lymfocyty s výraznou jadernou atypií a ložiskovým epidermotropismem. Nález svědčí pro mycosis fungoides; PCR prokázala klonální populaci T-buněk a diagnózu potvrdila.

cases.comment_source: The skin shows a nodular upper dermal infiltrate comprising of intermediate to large atypical lymphocytes. These cells showed an abnormal CD4+ phenotype. There is focal infiltration of the epidermis. The features are consistent with plaque phase mycosis fungoides. But in view of highly atypical cellular morphology and pattern of infiltration skin involvement by a systemic T-cell lymphoma needs to be excluded.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Mycosis fungoides PubMed Comment: The skin shows a nodular upper dermal infiltrate comprising of intermediate to large atypical lymphocytes. These cells showed an abnormal CD4+ phenotype. There is focal infiltration of the epidermis. The features are consistent with plaque phase mycosis fungoides. But in view of highly atypical cellular morphology and pattern of infiltration skin involvement by a systemic T-cell lymphoma needs to be excluded.
cases.category_cs: Hematolymfoidní, systémová, metastatická a ostatní vzácná onemocnění
cases.comment_cs: V horní dermis je nodulární infiltrát středně velkých až velkých atypických lymfocytů s abnormálním CD4+ fenotypem a ložiskovou infiltrací epidermis. Nález odpovídá plakové fázi mycosis fungoides. Vzhledem k výrazně atypické morfologii buněk a způsobu infiltrace je však nutné vyloučit kožní postižení systémovým T-buněčným lymfomem.

cases.comment_source: The fragment of skin shows mild hyperkeratosis. There is a band link lymphoid infiltrate in the superficial dermis. This is seen alongside a perivascular infiltrate within the dermis. The infiltrates are predominantly of CD4+ T-cells which showed a normal phenotype. Similar findings were seen on a previous biopsy that showed T-cell clonality. Collectively the features are sufficient for diagnosis of mycosis fungoides.
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Mycosis fungoides PubMed Comment: The fragment of skin shows mild hyperkeratosis. There is a band link lymphoid infiltrate in the superficial dermis. This is seen alongside a perivascular infiltrate within the dermis. The infiltrates are predominantly of CD4+ T-cells which showed a normal phenotype. Similar findings were seen on a previous biopsy that showed T-cell clonality. Collectively the features are sufficient for diagnosis of mycosis fungoides.
cases.category_cs: Hematolymfoidní, systémová, metastatická a ostatní vzácná onemocnění
cases.comment_cs: Fragment kůže vykazuje mírnou hyperkeratózu. V povrchové dermis je pásovitý lymfoidní infiltrát doprovázený perivaskulárním infiltrátem v dermis. Převládají CD4+ T-buňky s normálním fenotypem. Podobný nález byl v předchozí biopsii, kde byla prokázána T-buněčná klonalita. Souhrnně je nález dostatečný pro diagnózu mycosis fungoides.

cases.clinical_source: Lesion scalp: part solid, part cystic. Excised.
cases.comment_source: Mean 2.48/5 This case was chosen as a good example of a skin lesion which might be encountered by any pathologist working in a District General Hospital. Proliferating pilar tumours are regularly encountered in routine practice and it is important that these lesions are not misdiagnosed as squamous cell carcinomas. Pass marks were awarded to candidates able to give a competent description, appreciate the pilar nature of the lesion and arrive at a diagnosis of proliferating pilar tumour or a differential diagnosis favouring this lesion. Additional marks were awarded to candidates adding additional value by stating that excision is not complete, understanding the histogenesis of these lesions and indicating knowledge of epidemiological factors. Borderline fails were given to those candidates lacking confidence, equivocating between benign and malignant diagnoses. Clear fails were given for confident diagnoses of malignancy, or for diagnoses of pilar cyst NOS (and failing to appreciate the proliferative nature of this lesion). This case was answered adequately by most candidates, with a few managing to add value and score additional marks. A minority of candidates offered inappropriate diagnoses of malignancy by diagnosing squamous cell carcinoma or trichilemmal carcinoma. Some candidates made inappropriate benign diagnoses, including pilomatricoma.
