cases.comment_source: Mean 2.51/5 This was an intentionally difficult case, set to consider the ability of candidates to evaluate a spindle cell neoplasm of skin. There were some clues in the lower epidermis which might alert candidates to the likely melanocytic nature of the lesion: it would however be regarded as good practice to confirm this diagnosis immunohistochemically. The marking scheme was set to reward candidates considering malignant melanoma in a differential diagnosis whilst at the same time considering other forms of spindle cell neoplasia of skin and using an appropriate panel of immunohistochemical markers to determine the final diagnosis. Candidates gained additional marks by indicating an appropriate and complete immunohistochemical panel or by providing a better than average description, noting the changes in the lower epidermis that might raise suspicion of malignant melanoma. Candidates favouring melanoma and noting the need to establish BRAF status were also rewarded. Candidates whose approach was over-confident and who did not consider the need for immunochemical staining were marked down. Candidates arriving at confident diagnosis of other forms of spindle cell neoplasia of skin without immunohistochemical staining were given clear fails, as were candidates arriving at benign diagnoses. Despite being a difficult case candidates answered this question well, with the majority achieving pass marks and a significant proportion of candidates also adding value. A few candidates lost marks by unfocused differentials, inappropriate immunohistochemistry (not including stains to consider the possibility of melanoma) and also over-confident diagnosis of other forms of cutaneous neoplasia.

cases.clinical_source: Itchy purple lesion, left wrist. Biopsy.
cases.comment_source: Mean 2.55/5 This was a straightforward case, set to consider the ability of candidates to evaluate an inflammatory process in a skin biopsy. Lichen planus is a common disorder, encountered in routine practice in most DGH Pathology Departments. To gain a pass mark candidates were expected to identifying the correct inflammatory pattern (lichenoid) and to give a differential diagnosis including lichen planus. Additional marks were given to candidates making a confident diagnosis of lichen planus and giving better than average description. Candidates indicating some clinical knowledge of lichen planus were also given additional marks, especially those candidates correlating clinical signs and symptoms with the histology. Candidates describing an inflammatory lesion without noting the lichenoid nature of the process were given borderline fails. Clear fails were given to candidates who did not recognise this as an inflammatory dermatosis, to candidates arriving at malignant diagnosis and to candidates making confident diagnoses of blistering skin disorders. This case was answered well by most candidates with many managing to add some value by better than average descriptions or clinical correlations. A minority of candidates failed to notice the lichenoid nature of the inflammatory infiltrate and a small number of candidates made inappropriate diagnoses of blistering skin disorders and neoplasia. The most common error was to fail to note the lichenoid nature of the inflammatory infiltrate and favour a diagnosis of discoid lupus erythematosus.

This case was answered well by most candidates with many managing to add some value by better than average descriptions or clinical correlations. A minority of candidates failed to notice the lichenoid nature of the inflammatory infiltrate and a small number of candidates made inappropriate diagnoses of blistering skin disorders and neoplasia. The most common error was to fail to note the lichenoid nature of the inflammatory infiltrate and favour a diagnosis of discoid lupus erythematosus.

cases.comment_source: Mean 2.36/5 This case was set to consider the ability of candidates to recognise diagnostic features in a difficult spindle cell neoplasm of soft tissue which retained some features of neurilemmoma, complicated by other degenerative features. This is a problem which will be encountered by many pathologists in routine practice. Pass marks were awarded to candidates able to identify the features of neurilemmoma and give a competent description of the various histological changes. Additional marks are given to those candidates giving a better than average description and making a confident final diagnosis, indicating the need for appropriate immunohistochemistry. Fail marks were awarded to candidates arriving at malignant diagnosis. Borderline fails were given to candidates offering broad differential diagnoses of benign lesions without a preferred diagnosis, or diagnosing other benign connective tissue neoplasms, especially myofibroblastic lesions. This case was answered variably by candidates. A majority of candidates arrived at the correct diagnosis and some added value by offering good descriptions and appropriate use of immunohistochemistry. A significant minority of candidates were misled by the histological features and arrived at inappropriate malignant diagnoses. A few candidates lacked confidence and resorted to extensive differential diagnoses. There was a common tendency to over-state the vascular elements and conclude that this was a vascular neoplasm.

Skin biopsy taken from the face shows numerous yeast or spore forms of fungi 2-10 microns in size a) If the fungi shows broad based budding with morules, what is your diagnosis? b) If the fungi are PAS positive, GMS positive and Mucicarmine negative what is your diagnosis? c) If the fungi show spherules containing numerous endospores measuring 5 microns to 15 microns in size what is your diagnosis? d) If the fungi show broad based budding but no morula formation what is your diagnosis?
cases.clinical_cs: Recidivující papulózní vyrážka na obličeji po dobu jednoho roku a otok levého kolena po dobu 6 měsíců. Pacient má kombinovanou T- a B-buněčnou imunodeficienci. Biopsie kůže obličeje ukazuje četné kvasinkové či sporové formy hub o velikosti 2–10 μm. a) Pokud houba vykazuje širokobazální pučení s morulami, jaká je diagnóza? b) Pokud je PAS a GMS pozitivní a mucikarmín negativní, jaká je diagnóza? c) Pokud houba tvoří sféry s četnými endosporami o velikosti 5–15 μm, jaká je diagnóza? d) Pokud vykazuje širokobazální pučení bez tvorby morul, jaká je diagnóza?

cases.clinical_source: Left posterior scalp. ? Large SCC Macroscopic description Disc of skin 48 x 47 x 10mm with central raised firm lesion 39 x 33 x 12mm. Note yellow ulceration in centre of the lesion 12mm in maximum extent. Slides provided. H&E, ALK-1, CD3, CD4, CD8, CD15, CD20, CD30, Ki-67 Positive controls have been run for each of the stains, where relevant, and are satisfactory. Negative controls are also satisfactory. Histological morphology: Skin showing a large ulcerated multi-nodular tumour composed of a dense dermal infiltrate made up of a polymorphous population of cells. There are neutrophils, eosinophils, small lymphoid cells, histiocytes and numerous large cells with pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli. Occasional multinucleated giant cells are also present. The overlying epidermis is ulcerated and there is no epidermotropism. Sclerosis is also noted. There is focal extension into the sub-cutis. Description of special stains: POSITIVE in large cells - CD3, CD4, CD30 NEGATIVE in large cells - CD20, CD7, ALK1, CD15 Ki-67: approximately 30-40 % in large cells.

Epidermis ulcerovaná, bez epidermotropismu; přítomna skleróza a fokální šíření do podkoží. Velké buňky CD3, CD4 a CD30 pozitivní; CD20, CD7, ALK1 a CD15 negativní; Ki-67 přibližně 30–40 %.

cases.comment_source: These slides show a poorly circumscribed tumour which appears to be within the subcutaneous fat. The tumour has an ill-defined infiltrative margin and is composed of plump spindle cells with central rounded nuclei and prominent nucleoli. There is marked variation in nuclear size and shape with some very large irregular nuclei noted. In addition there is an admixed inflammatory cell infiltrate composed of neutrophils and histiocytes. Centrally the lesion shows large ectatic vascular channels, many of which have thrombosed. Prominent iron deposition is noted. Focal fat infiltration and dystrophic calcification is noted. Immunohistochemistry (not shown) was positive for CD34, CD68 which highlighted many histiocytes. The lesion was negative for desmin, SMM, SMA, S100 and Melan-A. The features are those of a pleomorphic hyalinising angioectatic tumour. These tumours are regarded as indeterminate (locally aggressive) lesions with a tendency for local recurrence but no metastatic potential is reported. Using a break-apart DNA probe which hybridises to the TGFBR3 locus at 1p22.1, the tumour cells showed rearrangement of this region with loss of the red (centromeric) 5' region. TGFBR3 rearrangements are reported in pleomorphic hyalinising angioectatic tumour.

cases.comment_cs: Preparáty ukazují špatně ohraničený nádor zřejmě uložený v podkožním tuku. Má neostře infiltrativní okraj a je tvořen robustními vřetenitými buňkami s centrálními kulatými jádry a výraznými jadérky. Velikost a tvar jader výrazně kolísají, místy jsou velmi velká nepravidelná jádra. Je přítomen zánětlivý infiltrát neutrofilů a histiocytů. Centrálně jsou velké ektatické cévní kanály, mnohé trombotizované, s výraznými depozity železa. Ložiskově je infiltrace tuku a dystrofická kalcifikace. IHC: CD34 pozitivní; CD68 zvýrazňuje četné histiocyty; desmin, SMM, SMA, S100 a Melan-A negativní. Nález odpovídá pleomorfnímu hyalinizujícímu angiektatickému tumoru. Tyto nádory jsou považovány za léze nejistého potenciálu, lokálně agresivní a s tendencí k lokální recidivě, bez popsaného metastatického potenciálu. Break-apart sondou pro lokus TGFBR3 na 1p22.1 byla prokázána přestavba této oblasti se ztrátou červeného centromerického 5' signálu. Přestavby TGFBR3 jsou u tohoto nádoru popisovány.

cases.clinical_source: Very itchy reticular and hyperpigmented rash under breast and left groin for 6 years . ? lichen planus ? mycosis fungoides. On immunohistochemistry there is a predominant CD8+ T cell infiltrate with loss of CD5 and CD7, and preserved CD2 and CD3. CD30 stains a few cells. T cell clonality was detected on PCR. The favoured diagnosis is: A) Lichen planus B) Lichenoid mycosis fungoides C) CD8+ Epidermotropic T cell lymphoma D) Lymphomatoid papulosis
cases.comment_source: close d/d lichenoid mycosis fungoides but clinically stable rash for 10 years and hence more in keeping with lichen planus
cases.details_source: Diagnosis: Lichen planus PubMed Comment: close d/d lichenoid mycosis fungoides but clinically stable rash for 10 years and hence more in keeping with lichen planus
cases.clinical_cs: Velmi svědivá retikulární hyperpigmentovaná vyrážka pod prsem a v levém třísle po dobu 6 let. ?lichen planus, ?mycosis fungoides. IHC: převažuje infiltrát CD8+ T-lymfocytů se ztrátou CD5 a CD7, CD2 a CD3 zachovány; CD30 barví několik buněk. PCR prokázala klonalitu T-buněk. Preferovaná diagnóza: A) Lichen planus B) Lichenoidní mycosis fungoides C) CD8+ epidermotropní T-buněčný lymfom D) Lymfomatoidní papulóza.
cases.comment_cs: Těsná diferenciální diagnóza s lichenoidní mycosis fungoides, klinicky je však vyrážka stabilní 10 let, a proto nález více odpovídá lichen planus.

cases.clinical_source: Widespread rash, papular + haemorrhagic centre. 1 week, ?Vasculitis. On immunohistochemistry the clusters of larger T-cells express CD30 and show some loss of CD7 and are mostly CD4 and CD8 negative. No clone detected and no gene rearrangement. TCR beta polyclonal TCR gamma polyclonal. The favoured diagnosis is: A) PLEVA B) Drug reaction C) Mycosis fungoides D) Lymphomatoid papulosis
cases.clinical_cs: Rozsáhlá papulózní vyrážka s hemoragickým centrem, trvá 1 týden, ?vaskulitida. IHC: shluky větších T-buněk exprimují CD30, s částečnou ztrátou CD7, většinou CD4 a CD8 negativní. Klon neprokázán, bez genového přeskupení; TCR beta polyklonální, TCR gamma polyklonální. Preferovaná diagnóza: A) PLEVA B) Léková reakce C) Mycosis fungoides D) Lymfomatoidní papulóza.

cases.clinical_source: Developed maculopapular rash 48 hours ago on upper back. Now on chest starting on face. On immunohistochemistry the infiltrate is entirely T-cells with CD4+ phenotype with strong CD52 and no loss of Pan T cell markers. TCR gammaclonal. The favoured diagnosis is: A) Polymorphous light eruption B) Viral rash C) T-cell prolymphocytic leukaemia D) Drug reaction
cases.clinical_cs: Makulopapulózní vyrážka vznikla před 48 hodinami na horní části zad, nyní na hrudníku a začíná na obličeji. IHC: infiltrát tvoří výhradně T-buňky s fenotypem CD4+, silnou expresí CD52 a bez ztráty pan-T markerů. TCR gamma klonální. Preferovaná diagnóza: A) Polymorfní světelná erupce B) Virový exantém C) T-buněčná prolymfocytární leukémie D) Léková reakce.
cases.category_cs: Hematolymfoidní, systémová, metastatická a ostatní vzácná onemocnění

cases.clinical_source: Plaques and indurated nodules on legs, arms and one on the left upper eyelid since 2020. There are some follicular papules and pustules. There is some scarring alopecia on the arms over the plaques and nodules. There is a palpable lymph node in left axilla. There is no hepatosplenomegaly. No B symptoms. The skin is itchy particularly at night. On immunohistochemistry there is a T cell infiltrate with the following phenotype - CD2+ CD3+ CD30+/- CD4+ CD5+ CD7+/- CD8- IRF4+/- PD-1+/-, TCR betaclonal TCR gamma suspicious. The favoured diagnosis is: A) Intersitial granulomatous dermatitis B) Granulomatous mycosis fungoides C) Insect bite reaction D) Drug reaction
cases.clinical_cs: Plaky a indurované uzly na dolních končetinách, pažích a jeden na levém horním víčku od roku 2020. Přítomny i folikulární papuly a pustuly. Nad plaky a uzly na pažích je jizvící alopecie. Hmatná uzlina v levé axile. Bez hepatosplenomegalie a bez B-symptomů. Kůže svědí zejména v noci. IHC: T-buněčný infiltrát CD2+ CD3+ CD30+/- CD4+ CD5+ CD7+/- CD8- IRF4+/- PD-1+/-; TCR beta klonální, TCR gamma suspektní. Preferovaná diagnóza: A) Intersticiální granulomatózní dermatitida B) Granulomatózní mycosis fungoides C) Reakce na bodnutí hmyzem D) Léková reakce.

cases.clinical_source: HIV Positive. HEP B positive. Discontinued antiretroviral medication for several months. Admitted for feeling unwell, and found with several purple-red lesions 8 mm on left upper arm and right forearm. ?Kaposi sarcoma. Punch biopsy of one of the lesions. Specimen: Punch biopsy 4 mm diameter. Special stains/IHC results: HHV-8 positive.
cases.clinical_cs: HIV pozitivní, HBsAg pozitivní. Antiretrovirovou léčbu několik měsíců neužíval. Přijat pro celkovou nevolnost; nalezeno několik fialovočervených lézí velikosti 8 mm na levé paži a pravém předloktí, ?Kaposiho sarkom. Punch biopsie jedné léze. Vzorek: punch biopsie o průměru 4 mm. Speciální barvení/IHC: HHV-8 pozitivní.

cases.clinical_source: Suspected skin cancer right inframammary fold. Specimen: Ellipse of skin measuring 26 x 13 x 5 mm. The epithelial surface bears an eccentric, well-defined, raised, pale keratotic nodular lesion measuring 7 x 7 x 5 mm. The lesion lies less than 2 mm from the peripheral resection margin. The resection margin is inked in black. Special stains/IHC results: Diffuse strong positive staining for SMA and caldesmon. Negative: HMB45, ERG, CD31, CD34, AE1/AE3, p40, CK5/6, 34BETAE12, p63, CD68, MelanA, S100, SOX10 and desmin.
cases.clinical_cs: Suspektní kožní nádor v pravé inframamární rýze. Vzorek: elipsa kůže 26 × 13 × 5 mm. Na povrchu je excentrická, dobře ohraničená, vyvýšená, světlá keratotická nodulární léze 7 × 7 × 5 mm. Léze je méně než 2 mm od periferního resekčního okraje. Resekční okraj označen černě. Speciální barvení/IHC: difuzní silná pozitivita SMA a caldesmonu. Negativní HMB45, ERG, CD31, CD34, AE1/AE3, p40, CK5/6, 34BETAE12, p63, CD68, Melan-A, S100, SOX10 a desmin.
cases.category_cs: Mezenchymální, vaskulární, nervové a histiocytární léze
